command: set -u; export JAVA_HOME=$(/usr/libexec/java_home -v 21); export PATH="$JAVA_HOME/bin:$PATH"; ./gradlew --no-daemon :feature:radar:detekt >/tmp/tracker-v106d-detekt.log 2>&1; RC=$?; echo DETEKT_EXIT=$RC; cat /tmp/tracker-v106d-detekt.log; echo DETEKT_REPORTS; find feature/radar/build/reports -maxdepth 3 -type f -print 2>/dev/null | sort; for f in feature/radar/build/reports/detekt/*; do if [ -f "$f" ]; then echo REPORT_FILE=$f; case "$f" in *.txt|*.md|*.xml|*.sarif) cat "$f";; esac; fi; done; exit 0
